dataset: Par3 (Karpinska et al., 2022), pooled German/Russian/Chinese source books
system_prompt: You are a professional literary translator contributing English translations to an anthology of world literature.
note: Paragraphs pooled across German/Russian/Chinese source books, filtered to indices where >= min_translators different human translators simultaneously reach >= min_sentences sentences (see data_description/descriptive_analysis_par3.ipynb), then stratified-sampled down to n_paragraphs, split as evenly as possible across the three source languages (sample_quota_by_language) so the much larger Russian pool does not swamp German. French is structurally excluded (no French book has >= min_translators translators).
